saved mask comes from C13, which loads the npz written in C10 (files fetched by constructed date name, with an assert that each file's date matches). It builds per-day-of-year pools of ±5 days and takes the hazen 90th percentile, then applies the wrapped 31-day smoothing. It compares 2013-06-01..08-31 SST with the smoothed threshold per sea cell and runs per-cell MHW detection.
